key.lane: In two short paragraphs, explain why a regression test should replay real provider responses. No headings or lists, and do not use any tools.

content.text:
This standalone host supports the shared persona children with narrowed tools and tree budgets, the canonical askUser and submitPlan tools, workspace file read, write, string-replace, delete, rename and directory listing, file-name glob and symbol search, the task list, canvases and paging of oversized tool results. Its workspace roots: <workspace>. Content search, language-server inspection and shell tools, configured MCP/Tasks, Skills/workspace instructions, browser OAuth, local inference and vector Memory are unavailable. Use an existing desktop host for those capabilities.

Some capabilities are deferred: canvas documents, task lists, file delete/rename, directory listings, symbol and LSP inspection, tool-output artifacts. For the deferred inventory (MCP tools included) use list_available_tools; follow nextOffset until null. When a needed tool is not loaded — one these instructions, the catalog, or a skill activation names — load_tool its exact name before brainstrike_globWorkspace; when you only know the capability, search_tools with a concise query, then load_tool the match. Search returns at most three ranked matches, not the complete catalog, so never infer other tools are unavailable. If the search finds nothing, check the catalog for an exact name first. Loaded tools are callable on your next step within this same response ("next turn" in tool results means that step, not a later user message): call them right away; never end your reply to wait for a load.

WORKING_MEMORY_SYSTEM_INSTRUCTION:
Store and update any conversation-relevant information by calling the updateWorkingMemory tool. If information might be referenced again - store it!

Guidelines:
1. Store anything that could be useful later in the conversation
2. Update proactively when information changes, no matter how small
3. Use Markdown format for all data
4. Act naturally - don't mention this system to users. Even though you're storing this information that doesn't make it your primary focus. Do not ask them generally for "information about yourself"
5. IMPORTANT: When calling updateWorkingMemory, the only valid parameter is the memory field. DO NOT pass an object.
6. IMPORTANT: ALWAYS pass the data you want to store in the memory field as a string. DO NOT pass an object.
7. IMPORTANT: Data must only be sent as a string no matter which format is used.

Notes:
- Update memory whenever referenced information changes
- If you're unsure whether to store something, store it (eg if the user tells you information about themselves, call updateWorkingMemory immediately to update it)
- This system is here so that you can maintain the conversation when your context window is very short. Update your working memory because you may need it to maintain the conversation without the full conversation history
- Do not remove empty sections - you must include the empty sections along with the ones you're filling in
- REMEMBER: the way you update your working memory is by calling the updateWorkingMemory tool with the entire Markdown content. The system will store it for you. The user will not see it.
- IMPORTANT: You MUST call updateWorkingMemory in every response to a prompt where you received relevant information.
- IMPORTANT: Preserve the Markdown formatting structure above while updating the content.

function.name: brainstrike_askUser
function.description: Ask the user a clarifying question and WAIT for their answer (the run pauses). Provide options for a structured choice (selectionMode multi_select allows several), or omit options for a free-text question

options.description: Optional choices. Omit for a free-text question.

description.description: Optional context for the option (does not change the answer value).

label.description: Option label; the value returned when chosen.

question.description: The clear, specific question to ask the user.

selectionMode.description: How many options the user may pick. Requires options; defaults to single_select.

function.name: brainstrike_submitPlan
function.description: Submit a structured implementation plan (title, overview, ordered steps, optional risks/verification) for the user to Approve or Reject. The run PAUSES until they respond; rejection feedback is returned so you can revise and resubmit

overview.description: One or two paragraphs summarizing the plan and its goal.

risks.description: Optional risks, tradeoffs, or things that could go wrong.

verification.description: Optional how-to-verify: tests, checks, or acceptance criteria.

function.name: brainstrike_readWorkspaceFile
function.description: Read a file from a chosen open workspace root as bounded, line-numbered pages with a short thread-scoped continuation handle. For later pages pass only cursor (and optional maxChars); omit path/root/startLine/endLine

cursor.description: Short nextCursor handle from the previous page. Pass it unchanged with optional maxChars and omit every other field

endLine.description: Last 1-based line; omit with cursor unless replaying the original value unchanged

path.description: Workspace-relative file path; required only when starting a new read

root.description: Open-folder name/id. Omit for this thread's primary folder; an explicit root always wins.

startLine.description: First 1-based line; omit with cursor unless replaying the original value unchanged

function.name: brainstrike_writeWorkspaceFile
function.description: Write or create a UTF-8 file in a chosen open workspace root (overwrites existing content; refuses if the file changed on disk since you last read it — re-read and retry; workspace-scoped, requires approval). bytesWritten confirms it landed; skip re-reading

content.description: Full UTF-8 content (up to ~2 MB); overwrites an existing file

path.description: Workspace-relative path; creates missing parent directories

root.description: Open-folder name/id. Omit for this thread's primary folder; an explicit root always wins.

function.name: brainstrike_stringReplaceWorkspaceFile
function.description: Surgically edit a file in a chosen open workspace root by replacing one oldStr block with newStr (fuzzy-matched; refuses ambiguous matches; refuses if the file changed on disk since you last read it — re-read and retry; workspace-scoped, requires approval). matchType "exact" confirms verbatim placement; other matchTypes are fuzzy — re-read for precision

newStr.description: Replacement text; empty deletes the matched block

oldStr.description: Existing text block. Use whole lines and enough context to identify one location; ambiguous matches are refused.

root.description: Open-folder name/id. Omit for this thread's primary folder; an explicit root always wins.

function.name: brainstrike_globWorkspace
function.description: Enumerate workspace files whose path matches a glob (e.g. **/*.test.ts, src/**/*.tsx). One path per result line, prefixed with its root name when several folders are open. Excludes .git, build output, and gitignored paths by default; pass includeIgnored to see them; read-only

includeIgnored.description: Include excluded paths: build output, generated artifacts, and gitignored files such as coverage/ or .env* (default false)

pattern.description: Workspace-relative glob; bare patterns match at any depth

root.description: Open-folder name/id. Omit to search all of this thread's folders. Results include their root.

function.name: brainstrike_readToolOutputArtifact
function.description: Page/grep; never alter or recreate the cursor.

cursor.description: Prior cursor; copy byte-for-byte, never edit or recreate it.

function.name: updateWorkingMemory
function.description: Update the working memory with new information. Any data not included will be overwritten. Always pass data as string to the memory field. Never pass an object.

memory.description: The Markdown formatted working memory content to store. This MUST be a string. Never pass an object.

function.name: agent-explore
function.description: Delegate broad, RAG-native codebase exploration: semantic + exact search across the workspace, then read the most relevant files. Use when a question needs surveying many files before answering. Returns reported findings to verify, not established fact. Read-only leaf: cannot spawn child agents. For a hierarchy, choose an available worker-mode supervisor instead; do not assign onward delegation to this persona. Runs at most 100 steps, one of which is reserved for its summary — scope the task to that budget and split anything larger across several delegations. The root turn permits at most 3 descendant levels, 200 invocations, 6 active work operations, 32768 output tokens per child and 6553600 across descendants.

_background.description: Optional: override how this delegation executes. Omit it in most cases.

disposition.description: Run this delegation inline (foreground) or in the background (deferred).

enabled.description: false runs this delegation in the foreground.

function.name: agent-analyze
function.description: Delegate focused analysis that combines reading workspace files with external web research. Use when a question needs both in-repo reading and up-to-date external context. Returns reported findings to verify, not established fact. Read-only leaf: cannot spawn child agents. For a hierarchy, choose an available worker-mode supervisor instead; do not assign onward delegation to this persona. Runs at most 100 steps, one of which is reserved for its summary — scope the task to that budget and split anything larger across several delegations. The root turn permits at most 3 descendant levels, 200 invocations, 6 active work operations, 32768 output tokens per child and 6553600 across descendants.

_background.description: Optional: override how this delegation executes. Omit it in most cases.

disposition.description: Run this delegation inline (foreground) or in the background (deferred).

enabled.description: false runs this delegation in the foreground.

function.name: agent-worker
function.description: Delegate an authorized deliverable: implement changes, create artifacts, execute checks, or use eligible integrations. Returns a concise result with evidence and output paths. Can supervise child agents within the remaining depth budget. For hierarchical research, use workers as supervisors and read-only Explorers as leaves; keep each task within the user-authorized scope. Runs at most 100 steps, one of which is reserved for its summary — scope the task to that budget and split anything larger across several delegations. The root turn permits at most 3 descendant levels, 200 invocations, 6 active work operations, 32768 output tokens per child and 6553600 across descendants.

_background.description: Optional: override how this delegation executes. Omit it in most cases.

disposition.description: Run this delegation inline (foreground) or in the background (deferred).

enabled.description: false runs this delegation in the foreground.

function.name: list_available_tools
function.description: List eligible deferred tools, including MCP tools, without loading their schemas. Use for questions about what tools are available. Filter by name prefix (for example linear). Follow nextOffset until null for the complete inventory. To use a listed tool, call load_tool with its exact name first.

offset.description: Start at 0; use nextOffset for subsequent pages with the same prefix.

function.name: load_tool
function.description: Load one or more tools into your context. Call this after finding tools with search_tools. Once loaded, tools will be available for use. Pass a single toolName or an array of toolNames to load multiple tools at once.

toolName.description: The exact name of a tool to load (from search results)

toolNames.description: Array of exact tool names to load in one call (from search results)

function.name: search_tools
function.description: Search deferred capabilities this run: canvas documents, task lists, file delete/rename, directory listings, symbol and LSP inspection, including MCP tools, by keyword. Returns at most 3 ranked matches, not a complete inventory, and does not load them: call load_tool with the exact name(s) to use a match. If you already know a tool's exact name, call load_tool directly instead of searching. For the full inventory use list_available_tools.
